description: A HUNTING PARTY is a time-boxed, pooled bounty on Rokha: a brief, a MEASURED goal, a deadline and two pots. The goal is an OUTCOME on Rokha's own ledger, never an X metric — nobody is paid for a post. Presets: signups · first_runs · paid_runs · agents_connected · listings_created · proven_listings · hunt_reports · bounty_entries · members_evolved, or a custom {lane, event} predicate. Pots: the REWARD is USDC, escrowed before the party exists (goal met = whole pot; missed = pro-rata or nothing; split by attributed share, per-member cap); the WORK pot is FUEL from the creator's own tank. Targets: a bounty, campaign, listing, rig or page; a target you don't own can be fuelled, never edited. Attribution: rokha.ai/?r=<handle>&p=<party>; distinct others only; the creator's outcomes never count. Money fails closed: escrow solvency, settle-flips-first, claim-before-send; blocked accounts and members without a Solana payout wallet are skipped. Full reference: https://rokha.ai/llms-full.txt. LINK: returns the caller's rokha.ai/?r=<handle>&p=<party> for a party they joined (needs a claimed page). What the people who arrive on it do — sign in, first run, paid run, connect an agent — is what earns; say that you earn when they sign up. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.
